newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was little changed against the dollar in dull late trading on Thursday amid ample liquidity supply, dealers said.
"There is no drive at all in the market. I think many people are still away on holiday and Singapore operators were off for the general election," one local bank dealer said.
Spot rupiah was at 2,361.40/61.75 at 0900 GMT against an opening of 2,362.25/63.25. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,360.90/61.30 and 2,360.60/61.00, respectively.
Dealers said sentiment on the rupiah remained firm and help strengthen the rupiah in the morning trading.
One Japanese bank dealer said some operators were seen establishing fresh short outright positions following sustained ample liquidity supply.
Overnight swap was at 0.05/0.20 and tom/next at 0.40/0.45.
Dealers expected the market to normalise next Monday.
One-month swap was at 12.25/13.00, two at 25.25/25.50, three at 39.80/40.00 and six at 82.0/83.0 points.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention rate by one point to 2,360/2,552 and the conversion rate also by one point to 2,360/2,408 on Thursday.
